object.description: In the Document Editor, select an object with no incoming links and choose Delete, confirming; choose Delete on another object and decline; delete two objects in turn with the real confirmation. Expected: each delete asks first, with Cancel as the default and no option to stop asking; a confirmed delete removes the object and its file; a declined one changes nothing.
